blocked_products.energy_vs_radius: an A6 production path that varies the Alcubierre radius R and re-evaluates the frame stress-energy, the certification and the integrated objectives. A6 fixes R = 2 (kR in observer_checks.cpp and energy_integral_checks.cpp).
blocked_products.energy_vs_steepness: an A6 production path that varies the shape-function steepness sigma and re-evaluates the same quantities. A6 fixes sigma = 1 (kSig).
blocked_products.stress_eigenvector_field: an exported eigenbasis of S_ij. geometry::detail::orthonormal_eigenbasis computes one but it is internal to the NEC minimiser and no record carries it.

cases.name: v0a6.scientific_gate_passed
cases.claim: the A6 numerical gate exists and passed, so the observers, the energy density and the certification behind these visuals are verified rather than merely computed
cases.expected: A6 gate all_passed with zero failures

cases.name: v0a6.capability_audit_present
cases.claim: the capability audit exists, classifies every quantity with the closed four-value vocabulary, and names a blocked product for every capability it calls unimplemented
cases.expected: 25 capabilities, every classification in the vocabulary
cases.computed: 25 capabilities, 0 unclassifiable, 2 not implemented, 3 blocked products named
cases.note: a quantity absent from production must be visible as absent, not inferred from a neighbouring column

cases.name: v0a6.every_visual_has_a_production_source
cases.claim: every produced figure names a saved A6 record it was drawn from, and that record exists
cases.computed: all 12 figures trace to an exported CSV

cases.name: v0a6.unsupported_products_blocked
cases.claim: every product the A6 science cannot support is declared BLOCKED_BY_UNIMPLEMENTED_SCIENCE with its exact dependency, and none of them was drawn anyway
cases.computed: 3 blocked, all declared, none drawn: energy_vs_radius, energy_vs_steepness, stress_eigenvector_field

cases.name: v0a6.static_figures_exist
cases.claim: every required A6 figure is present as a PNG with sane dimensions

cases.name: v0a6.pngs_nonblank
cases.claim: no A6 figure is blank

cases.name: v0a6.svgs_parse
cases.claim: every figure has a well-formed SVG companion

cases.name: v0a6.animation_manifest_parses
cases.claim: the animation manifest parses and carries an entry for every animation and format

cases.name: v0a6.animation_status_is_honest
cases.claim: every manifest entry that claims a file exists has one, and every unwritten entry carries a reason
cases.computed: 16 entries honest; 16 written, 0 unwritten with a reason
cases.note: a missing video encoder must not fail this gate: the GIFs, the frames and the contact sheets are the deterministic products

cases.name: v0a6.contact_sheets_exist
cases.claim: each animation has a nonblank contact sheet, so a regression is visible without opening a video

cases.name: v0a6.frame_counts_agree
cases.claim: the frame records, the summary rows, the manifest entries and the manifest provenance all report the same frame count

cases.name: v0a6.fixed_global_scales_declared
cases.claim: the animations declare a colour scale computed once from the whole sweep and frozen, and record the limits themselves
cases.expected: fixed scale declared with explicit limits
cases.computed: fixed globally across all frames, computed once from the who | limits ['N_min', 'rho']
cases.note: a per-frame autoscale makes a field that grew by an order of magnitude look constant while only its noise appears to move

cases.name: v0a6.observers_remain_distinct
cases.claim: all four observer families appear as separate rows in every frame and are never merged

cases.name: v0a6.no_invalid_observer_presented_as_physical
cases.claim: no inadmissible observer carries a measured energy density, and the coordinate-stationary observer is never marked valid where g_00 >= 0
cases.expected: zero invalid observers presented as physical
cases.computed: 7 rejected observer rows, none of them plotted
cases.note: normalising by |g_00| there would produce a plausible, plottable, entirely fictitious energy density

cases.name: v0a6.exact_and_smooth_objectives_distinct
cases.claim: the exact objective and the softplus surrogate are separate columns with different values, and the surrogate width is recorded
cases.note: softplus systematically overestimates max(0,x) near zero, which is exactly where certification happens

cases.name: v0a6.integrated_objectives_close
cases.claim: the integrated objectives satisfy |E_net-(E_+-E_-)| < eps and |E_abs-(E_++E_-)| < eps on the saved values

cases.name: v0a6.optimization_readiness_is_earned
cases.claim: no velocity is marked optimization-ready while its integral is boundary-dominated or its exterior tail is comparable to its value
cases.expected: boundary share < 0.35 and tail < 25% of E_-
cases.computed: worst boundary share 0.0170, 0 velocities failing the tail test, readiness flags ['1']

cases.name: v0a6.certification_status_displayed
cases.claim: every figure's sidecar declares that certification status is shown and that the renderer computed no physics

cases.name: v0a6.source_checksums_agree
cases.claim: every figure sidecar names its input records and their SHA-256 still matches the bytes on disk
cases.computed: 17 input checksums checked, 0 mismatched, 0 sidecars missing, 0 of 25 recorded record hashes drifted
cases.note: a figure whose input bytes have changed is stale, and stale is indistinguishable from correct by eye

cases.name: v0a6.renderer_imports_no_a6_physics
cases.claim: no A6 renderer imports warp_hypad or calls an observer, tetrad, NEC or certification routine
cases.expected: zero physics in the A6 renderer package
cases.note: this is the case that keeps the visualization contract true as the package grows

cases.name: v0a6.anomaly_report_clean
cases.claim: the anomaly report exists, ran every required diagnostic, and has zero fired cases
cases.note: a fired anomaly does not suppress the figure; it fails this gate while the evidence survives

cases.name: v0a6.deterministic_rerender_metadata
cases.claim: the sweep manifest records everything a rerender needs, and the established sequence is preserved: exact_onset_frame 8, first_spatial_contour_frame 9
cases.note: at onset the field only touches zero, so no contour is supported until the next frame -- the V0.1A convention, unchanged
